projects.name: IDOT Multi-Year Improvement Program - Roadway FY 2027-2031
projects.notes: IDOT's published FY 2026-2031 Multi-Year Program (Publicatio = '20262031MULTI-YEAR SQ'), hosted on IDOT's ArcGIS Online account despite the service name 'MYP_Test'. All planned. Layers: 0 Structure FY 2026 (point), 1 Structure FY 2027-2031 (point), 2 Spot FY 2026 (point), 3 Spot FY 2027-2031 (point), 4 Roadway FY 2026 (polyline), 5 Roadway FY 2027-2031 (polyline). The FY 2026 layers are the current annual program (soonest to construction). No letting date: ProgramYea is the year within the program (2-6 here). Improvem_1..Improve_11 hold up to 11 improvement types; ProjectTam is the asset-management category; EstimatedC is text with commas. County1..County4.

projects.name: IDOT Multi-Year Improvement Program - Structure FY 2027-2031
projects.notes: Bridge/structure projects of the same program; fewer attributes than the roadway layer (no county field). Sample Improvem_1: 'Bridge Replacement'.
